en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an elevated view of a coastal city with many low-rise buildings and a harbor. The foreground and midground are filled with white colonial-style buildings, and the sea with several ships can be seen in the background. The text at the bottom reads 'LOANDA — Cidade baixa,' which translates to 'Loanda — Lower city.' The left bottom corner includes the words 'COLLECÇÃO MORAES - LOANDA.'
